row.notes: Driver Career contracts manager: moves the driver's secret meetings on. Returns when the driver has no DriverSecretMeetings record (contracts+0x3a8..+0x3b0, record +0x40) or when his contract (contract_owner +0x298 list, DriverContract +0x50 driver) is active (+0x2c), its removedReason (+0x12) is not 10, it runs more than one season (+0x20 > 1) and does not end this season (+0x24 != time component +0x428). No current meeting (record +0x18 null): it takes the first meeting definition with id 0 (contracts+0x298..+0x2a0, 20-byte entries), picks a team with 0x140d7f830 (a random team of the driver's rank window, 0x140d80bc0) and calls Game_DriverContracts_OfferSecretMeeting(contracts, def, team, driver, 3, notify). A current meeting with reason (+0x14) 3 (offered, waiting for the player) is left alone. Any other reason (0 declined, 1 accepted, set by the secret meetings view model 0x1422fca00 just before its tail call) is resolved: 0x140d7fe80 works out the next definition id (reason 1 takes the definition's +0x08, 0 its +0x0c and adds the meeting's team to the ignored teams of the offers at contracts+0x3c8; it also updates the driver's 0x5c-byte entries of the component at contracts+0x380 (+0x460), and the reason 1 path ends in 0x14106bf60), the current meeting is moved onto the record's previous meetings (+0x28..+0x30) by 0x140d83cd0, which nulls record +0x18 (0x140d83d72/0x140d83db8), so the vt+0x38 free after it (0x140d803cf/0x140d8041b) finds nothing and the meeting lives on in the previous meetings; then the next definition, when one has that id, is offered (reason 3; a next definition with kind byte +0x10 == 0 after a non-accept gets a newly picked team, otherwise the meeting's team); with no such definition and notify set it posts ProcessSMMessage (vtable 0x145698190, meeting id -1) for the human. Callers: the daily tick 0x14126a1a0 (vtable 0x1456cdee8; its loop over contracts+0x3a8 calls 0x140d7f220 then this with notify 0 at 0x14126b899) and the secret meetings view model command handler 0x1422fca00 (vtable 0x14577dd20; commands 0xe47022a1 sets reason 0, 0xb027c7fd sets 1, then jmp here with notify 1 at 0x1422fcc89). Season change (contracts vtable +0x188, 0x140d76570) frees every current and previous meeting. Raised by laneS (Progressive Career lane S: secret meetings in follow mode).

verify.notes: V1064 Proto (rcx contracts, edx driver, r8b notify) and both callers confirmed (call 0x14126b899 disp 0x14126b89a in 0x14126a1a0, notify 0, after filter 0x140d7f220; tail jmp 0x1422fcc89 in 0x1422fca00, notify 1, after the command handler writes current+0x14 = 0 at 0x1422fcc6b or 1 at 0x1422fcaa3; no other rel32 or pointer refs). Early return confirmed: DriverContract in contracts+0x350 +0x298..+0x2a0 with +0x2c set, +0x12 (removedReason) != 10, +0x20 (contractLength) >= 2 and +0x24 (seasonToRemove) != time+0x428 (claim omits the removedReason != 10 term). No current: offers the definition whose id == 0 with team from 0x140d7f830, reason 3. Current +0x14 == 3: returns. CORRECTION: other values are NOT freed. 0x140d83cd0(record+0x20, record+0x10) is a move push_back into previousMeetings that nulls record+0x18 (0x140d83d72/0x140d83db8), so the following reset's vt+0x38 free at 0x140d803cf/0x140d8041b is dead and the meeting object lives on in previous_begin..previous_end. Also: the next id comes from 0x140d7fe80 (reason 2/3 keep +0x00, 1 takes def +0x08, 0 takes def +0x0c and adds team +0x20 to the ignore list +0x3c8); if no definition has that id the meeting is still archived and, with notify, a message with meeting id -1 is posted instead of an offer; a next definition with +0x10 == 0 after a non-accept (reason != 1) gets a newly picked team, else the old team +0x20 is kept. Fix wording to: pushed (moved) onto previous meetings and current cleared, then the next definition offered when one exists.

V1066 sigcheck.py: hits=1 match=target=0x140d80190. Independent byte search of the 22-byte prologue pattern (push r15..rbx; sub rsp,0xd8; mov rdi,rcx): 1 hit in .xtls, 0 in .data1/.text1. Target is the function start of Game_DriverContracts_AdvanceSecretMeeting. The pattern is a generic prologue with no field offset in it, so it is unique now but fragile across builds.

V1079 Re-check of the corrected row (supersedes the V1064 partial). Holds against the code: early return incl. removedReason != 10; id-0 offer with 0x140d7f830 team and reason 3; reason 3 left alone; move into previous meetings via 0x140d83cd0 nulling record+0x18 (0x140d83d72/0x140d83db8) so the vt+0x38 free is dead; next id from 0x140d7fe80 (r9 = current meeting: 2/3 keep +0x00 at 0x140d80019, 1 takes +0x08 at 0x140d7ff1c, 0 takes +0x0c at 0x140d80030 and appends team +0x20 to the contracts+0x3c8 entry); offer only when a definition has the id; new team only for def +0x10 == 0 after reason != 1 (0x140d805bc); message 0x145698190 with meeting id -1 (movabs 0x3fff0000ffffffff at 0x140d80591) when none and notify. Callers and vtables confirmed by abs scan: 0x14126a1a0 in 0x1456cdee8, 0x1422fca00 in 0x14577dd20 (commands 0xe47022a1 -> 0, 0xb027c7fd -> 1); 0x140d76570 at 0x145690218 = vtable 0x145690090 +0x188. Wording nit: the 0x140d7fe80 side effects (tail jmp 0x14106bf60 at 0x140d8017f, per-driver 0x5c-byte entries at +0x460) go through the component at contracts+0x380, not the +0x370 component (only read there for season/length); say +0x380 instead of the time component. Not re-derived: the rank-window description of 0x140d7f830/0x140d80bc0.
